summary_en: 190,000 shares (1.74% of shares outstanding), ¥500M maximum, execution window 17 Aug – 31 Dec 2026, method open-market purchase including ToSTNeT-3.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 10 August 2026, KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS Inc. (TSE Standard, Code 208A) announced a share buyback authorization by board resolution. The company will acquire up to 190,000 ordinary shares (1.74% of shares outstanding, calculated as 190,000 ÷ 10,892,576 shares ex-treasury) for a maximum expenditure of ¥500 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including ToSTNeT-3 off-board transactions, from 17 August through 31 December 2026. The stated purpose is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions and to return part of earnings to shareholders. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 107,424 treasury shares.
